translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

book.name: Roma
book.title: Ukanikorongi Ubana a Asu u Aza a Roma

content: Ama a va̱, ili iꞌya n lakai uciga iꞌya gba̱ aza a Yahuda a tsa̱ra̱ iwauwi. Kavasu ka va̱ ka la ubana a asu u Kashila̱.
N reve ta̱ a ka ciga ta̱ a gbashika Kashila̱, shegai a reve
ili iꞌya i tsu zuwa yi u wushi ama wa. A una̱ u nala, aku a ka ciga a gonuko kaci ka le ama a maci a ure u le. A ꞌyuwain utono ure u Kashila̱ u ɗa u tsu gonuko ama a woko ama a maci.
Kawauwi ka zuwa ta̱ Mele ma gono ma woko bawu ucira, tsa̱ra̱ Kashila̱ ka gonuko gba̱ aza ɗa a wushuki a woko ama a maci.
Gba̱ ama a ka fuɗa ta̱ a tsa̱ra̱ iwauwi
Musa korongu ta̱ tyoku ɗa Kashila̱ ka zuwa ama a woko ama a maci adama a ɗa a na̱ka̱i Mele karinga̱. U danai, “Uza ɗa baci dem u yain ili iꞌya Mele ma danai, wa tsa̱ra̱ ta̱ uma.”

Shegai ili iꞌya Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u wenishikei a kaci ka uwoko ama a maci a asu u upityanangu iꞌya na: “Kotsu vu tonuko kaci ka vunu, ‘Ya wa bana a zuba?’ wa.” (Wata, “Ya wa bana a zuba u ba u cipuka̱ Kawauwi utuwa̱ a likimba?”)
“Kpam kotsu vu dana, ‘Ya wa bana a asuvu a iyamba a asu u akushe?’ wa.” (Wata, “Ya wa bana a asuvu a iyamba u ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ Kawauwi a ukpa̱?”)
Ili iꞌya Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai iꞌya na: “Akani yi aꞌa̱ ta̱ evu n avu; aꞌa̱ ta̱ a una̱ u vunu kpam a katakasuvu ka vunu.” Uwenishike u upityanangu u ɗa tsa dansa̱ka u ɗa gai la vi.
Vu dana baci bawu uwonvo, “Yesu Asheku a ɗa,” kpam vu wushuku baci a katakasuvu ka vunu Kashila̱ ka ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ yi ta̱ a ukpa̱, Kashila̱ ka wauwa vu ta̱.
Tsu wushuku ta̱ n atakasuvu a tsunu, adama a nala a ɗa Kashila̱ ka gonuko tsu tsu woko dere. Kpam tsu dana ta̱ bawu u uwonvo, tsu wushuku ta̱, adama a nala a ɗa kpam tsu tsa̱ra̱i iwauwi.
Tyoku ɗa Kashila̱ ka danai a Tagara̱da u ne, “Shegai uza ɗa baci u pityanangi n eyi wa yan uwono wa.”

Na vi u ka̱na̱ ta̱ ya dem, kpaci aza a Yahuda n Awulawa a takpana wa. Asheku a te a ɗa, aya kpam wa lya tsugono tsu ama gba̱. Kpam aya u tsu zuwuka ko ya baci u yain kavasu ubana ara ne una̱ u shinga.
Tyoku ɗa Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai, “Uza ɗa baci dem u yain kavasu a asuvu a kala ka Asheku, wa tsa̱ra̱ ta̱ iwauwi.”
Niɗa ama a ka wushuku n Asheku kpam a foli yi u wauwa le, a taɓa baci upana ukuna u ne wa? Kpam niɗa a ka yan a pana bawu uza roku u tonuko le?
Niɗa aza roku a ka ba a tonuko le, Asheku a ɗa baci a suku le wa? Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u dana ta̱, “Ili i maza̱nga̱ iꞌya i pige an aza ɗa a ka tuko Kadyanshi ka Shinga a ka tuwa̱.”
Shegai aza a Yahuda a roku a wushuku n Kadyanshi ka Shinga ki wa. Tyoku u na, Ishaya matsumate u wecike ta̱, “Magono ma Zuba, uza wa̱ gba̱m la wa wushuku n ili iꞌya tsu danai?”
Ama a pana ta̱ Kadyanshi ka Shinga an uza roku u tonuko le ukuna u Kawauwi. A tsu gita̱ ta̱ a pana akani yi, aku a wushuku.
Shegai aza a Yahuda tani? A pana akani yi? Eye, a pana ta̱! Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u dana ta̱,

content.text: “A tonuko ta̱ ya dem akani yi.
A dansa ta̱ a ɗa a asu u mɓa̱ri mɓa̱ri u likimba.”

content: Shegai mayun ɗa aza a Isaraꞌila a revei? Eye, a reve ta̱. Ko a aꞌayin a Musa Kashila̱ ka dana ta̱,

content.text: “Ma zuwa vu ta̱ vu yain n malyon, n zuwuka baci iyamba i roku una̱ u shinga.
Ma zuwa vu ta̱ vu pana upan, n zuwuka baci Awulawa a ɗa ya wundya aꞌa̱ n ugboji wa una̱ u shinga.”

content: Ishaya dana ta̱ bawu uwonvo u da Magono ma Zuba ma danai,

content.text: “Aza ɗa bawu a zama mu, alya a tsa̱ra̱ mu.
N wenike ta̱ kaci ka va̱ a asu u aza ɗa bawu a foloi a wene mu.”

content: Shegai Kashila̱ ka yan ta̱ kadyanshi a kaci ka aza a Isaraꞌila,

content.text: “Gba̱ uliva̱ n tsu ba̱ra̱kpa̱ ta̱ akere a va̱ n wushi aryagbaji aza ɗa a ꞌyuwain mu una̱ka̱ karinga̱.”
